t2.thesis: PLTR has a ~13% implied move and a history of strong fundamental beats with mixed reactions (2 of last 4 up), so with demanding valuation and a stock down 6% in the last week the outcome is close to a coin flip with a slight lean from the base rate.
reasons: Base rate for buying at the entry open and selling at the next open is ~54%, and software/AMC cohorts match that
Last four prints split 2 up and 2 down despite EPS beats every time, so beats are already priced in
Fundamentals are very strong: 93% revenue growth, raised guidance, and an Oppenheimer and JPMorgan bullish setup (I4, I13, I17)
Valuation is steep and the 'negative ESP' and 'guidance must do more than beat' commentary signal a high bar (I8, I10)
The 13% implied move is large against realized vol (IV about 2.3x RV60), so options are pricing a rich event premium that could compress the move but not set a direction
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guidance and the FY2026 raise relative to the elevated whisper numbers, especially US commercial growth.

prior.from: I3 overall validation hit rate 0.542, AMC 0.538, software_internet 0.541; used ~0.54

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-10-30, so the 2026-11-02 earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how PLTR's stock reacted to it.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 2 points from 0.54: the stock is trading below recent highs with a weak tech tape and high expectations, offset by positive analyst initiations and upward EPS revisions.

theses.expected: Up: a big beat and guidance raise above consensus lifts the stock, as in Aug 2026 (+14.6%)
theses.mechanism: Accelerating US commercial growth and RDV growth reinforce the AI-sovereignty narrative and force estimates higher, and the stock is below its 52-week high with room to catch up
theses.wrong_if: Q4 guide implies growth deceleration or the beat is smaller than the roughly 9% revenue beat the market now expects

theses.expected: Down: sell the news despite a beat
theses.mechanism: Valuation of about 72x sales and 78x forward earnings leaves little room, as in Nov 2025 and May 2026 when beats were met with declines
theses.wrong_if: Guidance is raised by well above the sell-side's expected amount and the stock opens higher

theses.expected: Muted or flat move that resolves on the opening gap
theses.mechanism: The rich implied move leads to partial vol crush and positioning is balanced (put/call about 0.85)
theses.wrong_if: The after-hours move exceeds 8% in either direction

key_observations: Q3 revenue vs the $2.16B guide and consensus (about 84% growth)
US commercial revenue growth and RDV
Q4 revenue and adjusted operating income guidance
Webcast tone and the after-hours move
